description: Plan a public-transport journey anywhere in New South Wales — door to door, multi-leg, with every change, walking leg, line and departure/arrival time. AUTHORITATIVE for "how do I get from A to B on Sydney transport"; uses the same engine as the official TfNSW trip planner.

_apiKey.description: Transport for NSW API key. Free from https://opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au/.

arrive_by.description: Treat `when` as the desired ARRIVAL time instead of departure.

destination.description: Destination, in the same form as origin.

origin.description: Origin — a stop id (e.g. "200060"), or a "longitude:latitude:EPSG:4326" coordinate.

when.description: Optional ISO date-time of departure (e.g. "2026-09-18T08:30"). Defaults to now.

name: tfnsw_trip_plan
title: Tfnsw Trip Plan
